title: One Thing Today
look: Session board: the Today screen, a three-step loop, insight columns and memory cards on a dot-grid desk. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what needs you, jade for what's settled. The Sensei mark on the close.

scenes.name: Not a dashboard
scenes.desc: A wall of charts fades back; one card that needs a decision stays.

scenes.name: Today
scenes.desc: Today shows one finding with its receipt, a few supporting insights, first-turn resolution and recent sessions.

scenes.name: Observe, find, act
scenes.desc: Every surface observes, forms one finding, and offers one action: Apply, Review or Dismiss.

scenes.name: Still listening
scenes.desc: Early on it says 'Still listening' and offers nothing; once there is enough signal, findings start.

scenes.name: Now, Soon, Settled
scenes.desc: Insights sort into Now, Soon and Settled; one decision moves a card along.

scenes.name: Adopted for you
scenes.desc: What Sensei adopted for you: each memory with what, why, how and a seven-day usage strip.

scenes.name: Sensei
scenes.desc: End card with the Sensei mark: one thing today, with its receipt.
